title: thelypteris sambasensis
intro: Thelypteris sambasensis, commonly known as Sambas fern, is a species of fern in the family Thelypteridaceae. It is traditionally used in Southeast Asian folk medicine for its numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of various diseases such as fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Thelypteris sambasensis are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that exhibit antispasmodic, analgesic, and antipyretic activities. Further research is needed to confirm the extent of its health benefits and bioactive properties, but preliminary studies suggest potential applications in the treatment of various health conditions.
